Record Class BudgetService.Summary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.BudgetService.Summary
Record Components:
totalExpenses - the two anticipated costs added
totalFunds - the budget's three lines added
bottomLine - totalFunds minus totalExpenses
Enclosing class:
BudgetService
public static record BudgetService.Summary(String quarter, Budget budget, BudgetService.Side ta, BudgetService.Side ula, BigDecimal totalExpenses, BigDecimal totalFunds, BigDecimal bottomLine) extends Record
Everything the page shows for one quarter. ta or ula is null when the quarter has no recruitment of that type.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
